learning.learning_goal: Connect number names, numerals, and groups from 16 through 17.
learning.big_idea: A number tells how many dots there are.
novice_success_criteria: Recognize a number name and count a new arrangement.

screens.title: Meet 16–17.
screens.audio: Listen to the numbers. Count the dots. Then try it yourself.
